name: Avatar
signature: public sealed class Avatar : Asset, ISerializable

docs.summary: A rig: the skeleton a model was authored with, plus an optional humanoid mapping. The Motion avatar is built from them on first use.
The bone the rig hangs from, which root motion is measured against.
The human body mapping, or null on a generic rig. Call [`Invalidate`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Avatar~Invalidate) after editing it.
True once a humanoid rig has mapped successfully.
The Motion avatar, built on first use. A humanoid whose mapping fails is built as a generic rig. Null without a skeleton.
Drops the built avatar so the next use rebuilds it from the current description.
